audit_items.title: Does transaction validation reject nonce >= U64.MAX_VALUE?

phase1_findings.implementation_summary: ErrNonceMax is defined in core/error.go:81 as 'nonce has max value'. The nonce validation logic uses uint64 type in Go, which inherently prevents overflow beyond U64.MAX_VALUE. The error is returned when account nonce reaches maximum value.

gaps_identified: Need to verify exact comparison operator (>= vs >)
Need to trace where ErrNonceMax is raised in state transition
phase2_findings.test_coverage_assessment: Requires verification of test cases for boundary condition at U64.MAX_VALUE

phase3_findings.recommendation: Verify that nonce check occurs BEFORE increment and uses >= comparison

audit_items.audit_notes: Error type exists. Implementation appears correct but needs trace verification of where boundary check occurs in state_transition.go preCheck function.

audit_items.title: Does contract creation reject initcode > MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE?

phase1_findings.implementation_summary: InitCode size validation implemented at core/state_transition.go:379 and :524. Check uses params.MaxInitCodeSize constant. Condition: 'if isEIP3860 && contractCreation && len(st.data) > params.MaxInitCodeSize'. Returns ErrMaxInitCodeSizeExceeded with size details.

gaps_identified: Verify MaxInitCodeSize constant value matches EIP-3860 specification (49152 bytes)
phase2_findings.test_coverage_assessment: Implementation is gated by isEIP3860 flag which depends on chain rules

phase3_findings.recommendation: Implementation uses > operator which is correct per EIP-3860

audit_items.audit_notes: Implementation correctly checks initcode size. Uses strict greater-than comparison (>) allowing exactly MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE bytes.
